prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1179; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash. The mechanism of injury is plausible for the reported event. Over two visits, the patient was evaluated and managed conservatively with cervical range-of-motion assessment, muscle relaxant and anti-inflammatory medication, and a home stretching program. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical spine, including reduced range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider or reported by the patient. Treatment followed a usual course for this type of injury, with symptoms improving steadily and visit frequency tapering as the patient recovered. Billed services correspond to the care documented, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
